panels.title: Data disk free
panels.description: Free space of the ClickHouse data disk.

targets.rawSql: SELECT disk_free FROM metric_sampler.backend_disks SETTINGS use_query_cache = 0, join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.title: Parts on the data disk
panels.description: Bytes of active parts of every table on the local disk.

targets.rawSql: SELECT local_bytes FROM metric_sampler.backend_disks SETTINGS use_query_cache = 0, join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.title: Parts on the cold volume
panels.description: Bytes of active parts moved to the cold volume, which is read through a local cache.

targets.rawSql: SELECT cold_bytes FROM metric_sampler.backend_disks SETTINGS use_query_cache = 0, join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.title: Merges running
panels.description: Merges in progress; the IO guard of the summaries service stops them while the disk falls behind its writes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT merges FROM metric_sampler.backend_disks SETTINGS use_query_cache = 0, join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.title: Since the last ingest
panels.description: Seconds since the newest step of any run was ingested.

targets.rawSql: SELECT dateDiff('second', max(max_ingested_at), now64(3)) AS seconds FROM metric_sampler.step_index SETTINGS use_query_cache = 0, join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.title: Health windows pending
panels.description: Windows of ingested batches that the health loop of the summaries service has yet to refresh.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS windows FROM metric_sampler.health_pending_windows SETTINGS use_query_cache = 0, join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.title: Data disk throughput
panels.description: Bytes written to and read from the ClickHouse data disk per second.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, avgIf(value, metric = 'BlockWriteBytes_vdc') AS write, avgIf(value, metric = 'BlockReadBytes_vdc') AS read FROM metric_sampler.backend_host_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND metric IN ('BlockWriteBytes_vdc', 'BlockReadBytes_vdc') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time SETTINGS use_query_cache = 0, join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.title: Disk busy, IO wait and CPU
panels.description: Share of time the data disk was busy, and the host's IO wait, user and system CPU over all cores.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, avgIf(value, metric = 'BlockActiveTime_vdc') AS disk_busy, avgIf(value, metric = 'OSIOWaitTimeNormalized') AS io_wait, avgIf(value, metric = 'OSUserTimeNormalized') AS cpu_user, avgIf(value, metric = 'OSSystemTimeNormalized') AS cpu_system FROM metric_sampler.backend_host_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND metric IN ('BlockActiveTime_vdc', 'OSIOWaitTimeNormalized', 'OSUserTimeNormalized', 'OSSystemTimeNormalized') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time SETTINGS use_query_cache = 0, join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.title: Bytes written to parts
panels.description: Compressed bytes per second of the parts that inserts and merges wrote; merges rewrite inserted data.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) second) AS time, sumIf(size_in_bytes, event_type = 'NewPart') / greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS inserts, sumIf(size_in_bytes, event_type = 'MergeParts') / greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS merges FROM metric_sampler.backend_part_writes WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time SETTINGS use_query_cache = 0, join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident memory of the ClickHouse server and memory available on the host.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, avgIf(value, metric = 'MemoryResident') AS clickhouse_resident, avgIf(value, metric = 'OSMemoryAvailable') AS host_available FROM metric_sampler.backend_host_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND metric IN ('MemoryResident', 'OSMemoryAvailable') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time SETTINGS use_query_cache = 0, join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.title: Runs ingested in the last 3 days
panels.description: Newest collected, ingested and health-refreshed step of each run.

targets.rawSql: SELECT exp, run, max_step, last_collected_at, max_ingested_at, health_max_step, health_refreshed_at FROM metric_sampler.pipeline_freshness WHERE max_ingested_at >= now() - INTERVAL 3 DAY ORDER BY max_ingested_at DESC SETTINGS use_query_cache = 0, join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.title: Summaries behind the complete steps
panels.description: Summaries whose progress is behind the run's complete-step frontier (empty when every summary is caught up).

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.summary AS summary, c.exp AS exp, c.run AS run, c.complete_through AS complete_steps, max(p.complete_through) AS summarized, c.complete_through - summarized AS behind FROM metric_sampler.complete_steps_latest AS c INNER JOIN metric_sampler.summary_progress AS p ON p.exp = c.exp AND p.run = c.run WHERE c.last_ingested >= now() - INTERVAL 3 DAY GROUP BY summary, exp, run, complete_steps HAVING behind > 0 ORDER BY behind DESC LIMIT 50 SETTINGS use_query_cache = 0, join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

SELECT database, table, disk, parts, rows, bytes FROM metric_sampler.backend_table_sizes ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 25 SETTINGS use_query_cache = 0, join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.title: Failed backend queries in the last 6 hours
panels.description: Errors of the ingest and of the summary, health, cold tier and guard loops.

targets.rawSql: SELECT user, error, times, last FROM metric_sampler.backend_errors ORDER BY last DESC LIMIT 20 SETTINGS use_query_cache = 0, join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1
